item.dden.loongnova.dragon-scorchdsc:
Automatic pulse laser. Accepts only DDArsenal-Dragonbreath Energy Cells.
Structure damage 200; creature damage 175. Fires every 0.12 seconds, consuming 20 energy and 0.25% durability per shot.
item.dden.loongnova.dragon-breath-celldsc: Stores 1000 energy. Recharge at a charging station or refill through crafting.
item.dden.loongnova.gravity-beltdsc:
Waist equipment with climbing claws, flight, slow fall and 6u of tool storage. Accepts only DDArsenal-Dragonbreath Energy Cells.
Slow fall: 0.5 energy/second. Flight: hold Up (default W), consuming 8 energy/second.
item.dden.loongnova.dragon-breath-matterdsc: A synthetic material for crafting draconic equipment, obtainable only through crafting.
item.dden.loongnova.dragondsc: Experimental matter condensed into a tiny dragon, used to craft the Dragonclaw Wrench. Obtainable from traders, supply crates or Elder Thornbacks. Acquiring it unlocks the Dragonclaw Wrench recipe for you.
item.dden.loongnova.dragon-claw-wrenchdsc:
Melee and digging tool with Cutting, Hammering and Dragonization. Acquiring it unlocks the remaining basic DDArsenal crafting recipes for this character.
Right-click a drill pod to fill four casings with Boring Rounds.
Right-click a {0} to dragonize it into an LN-Spatial Membrane.
<color=#ffd54f>The Dragon has touched thy thoughts...</color>
item.dden.loongnova.rock-dragon-pickaxedsc: Digging and demolition tool. Base structure damage 375, creature damage 10, swing interval 0.1 seconds. Durability 1200; each successful strike spends one point. Breaks when depleted.
item.dden.loongnova.charge-prototypedsc: Manually cycled charge weapon with one magazine round and one chambered round; supports mixed ammunition. Hold attack to charge and release to fire: minimum 0.7 seconds, forced shot at full charge after 3 seconds. Cancelling after 1 second fires the round. Grants a private aiming guide and variable zoom while held in the main hand with a live chambered round.
item.dden.loongnova.bio-erasure-rounddsc: Dedicated sniper-cannon ammunition, one shot per item. Base structure damage 1 and creature damage 750, with one projectile. Damage increases after 1 second of charging, reaching ×4 at 3 seconds.
item.dden.loongnova.demolition-rounddsc: Dedicated sniper-cannon ammunition, one shot per item. Fires 30 pellets, each dealing base structure damage 200 and creature damage 25; full charge deals 1000/125 per pellet. Spread is 20° to either side. Damage increases after 1 second, reaching ×5 at 3 seconds.
item.dden.loongnova.explosive-rounddsc: Impact-detonated sniper-cannon ammunition, one shot per item. Explodes immediately on impact with a 12-tile radius, dealing 400 damage to non-player creatures and 500 to structures and destroying ordinary tiles. Players suffer concussion without direct limb or brain damage. No safety fuse; charge does not increase blast damage or radius.
item.dden.loongnova.drill-rounddsc: Dedicated sniper-cannon ammunition, one shot per item. Bores a 4×4-tile passage up to 150 tiles along the shot direction without mineral drops. Stops at infinite rock; other tiles can be destroyed. Does not directly damage creatures; charge does not increase its range.
item.dden.loongnova.spatial-drain-rounddsc: Dedicated sniper-cannon ammunition, one shot per item. On hitting liquid, clears the entire connected liquid region, including mixed liquids. Connections are orthogonal; separate pools are unaffected. Does not directly damage creatures.
item.dden.loongnova.emp-breach-rounddsc: Dedicated sniper-cannon ammunition, one shot per item. Clears traps and dangerous machinery in a 25×25-tile area around impact, including grabber, falling, bouncing and spike mushrooms, turrets, sonic cannons, coils, springboards, clamps, skull crushers, saws, pistons and barbed wire. Recovers them as drops without detonating mines. Opens hatches and dismantles scrap collectors and charging stations. Does not target characters or roaming creatures.
item.dden.loongnova.revival-rounddsc: There are no clear markings explaining this round, and you still cannot understand it. Yet its casing bears the bright green of life... perhaps it has an unusual effect?
item.dden.loongnova.medical-injectordsc: Rear-loaded medical injector with a concealed needle and one dedicated ampoule slot. Drag an ampoule onto it, then apply it to an existing limb in the medical panel. Drag the injector to the central inventory Use slot to eject its ampoule.
item.dden.loongnova.medical-ampouledsc: Single-use injector ampoule. Ampoule-Rapid Treatment lasts 10 seconds: the injected limb gains 20 muscle and skin health per second, with infection removal, strong bleeding and pain reduction, and 600 seconds of disinfection. Rapid treatment also treats sepsis and blood toxins, normalizes blood viscosity, reduces radiation by 1 per second, accelerates blood regeneration and corrects low or high blood pressure. This is followed by a 120-second Ampoule-Treatment Aftereffect: natural limbs gain 0.5 muscle and skin health and lose 0.5 infection per second, with continued pain relief.
item.dden.loongnova.regeneration-ampouledsc: Single-use injector ampoule. Inject an existing limb connected to an amputation; after 45 seconds, regrow 1–2 segments outward, each with 10% muscle and skin health. The injection site retains one quarter of its previous health, 20% of current actual blood volume is consumed, and unconsciousness lasts at least 60 seconds.
item.dden.loongnova.empty-ampouledsc: An ampoule cartridge vial for the Self First Aid Injector.
item.dden.loongnova.sealed-supply-cratedsc: A sealed DDArsenal supply crate; drag it to the central Use slot in your inventory to open it.
item.dden.loongnova.supply-cratedsc: A reusable supply container for storing equipment and supplies by dragging items into it.
item.dden.loongnova.dragon-claw-refitted-wren:
Melee and digging tool with Cutting, Hammering, Dragonization and Modification.
Retains the ET modified wrench's repair and limb-tool capabilities.
item.dden.loongnova.spatial-membranedsc: A compressed spatial membrane, surrounded by a force field so you need not worry about it becoming a dual-vector foil.
item.dden.loongnova.dual-space-componentdsc: A component that forms a two-phase space. You cannot understand it at all, yet you know what it can do. The Dragon has influenced your thoughts....
item.dden.loongnova.micro-space-supply-crated: A spatial hexahedron lies within. The Dragon's wisdom and power are unrivaled: time does not flow inside, and even without a battery your belongings will not be lost to spatial turbulence!
item.dden.loongnova.spatial-rechargerdsc:
Extracting energy through spatial turbulence—perhaps only the mighty dragons could achieve this.
The installed energy cell is merely an emergency support for the field; the module sustains its own cycle and still outputs an astonishing amount of energy.
item.dden.loongnova.tactical-gogglesdsc: Eye equipment providing wearer-only terrain outlines, hazard highlights, night vision and adjustable zoom. Detection follows the current screen, with extra-range warnings for ranged weapons, sonic cannons and traps directly below. Disables the local line-of-sight blackout in unchipped mode. Locates living, active elders within range on their native layer. Provides trader guidance within 500 meters.

Install a Dragonbreath Energy Cell first, then store batteries to recharge, including Dragonbreath Energy Cells.
